title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, capturing noise along with the underlying pattern. This results in poor performance on new, unseen data.

title: Strategies to Reduce Overfitting
text: To reduce overfitting, you can try techniques such as reducing model complexity, increasing training data, or using regularization methods.

title: Regularization Techniques
text: Regularization techniques like L1 (Lasso) and L2 (Ridge) add a penalty to the loss function to discourage overly complex models.

title: Adding an Intercept Term
text: Consider adding an intercept term to the model. This can help in capturing the baseline level of the response variable.
